column1: # Where each tool keeps its MCP server config. Separate from tools.tsv because
# MCP needs format (json/toml) and a merge key, not just a path.
#   mcp_global   user/global MCP config file ('-' if none)
#   mcp_project  project MCP config file ('-' if none)
#   container    where servers live: json key path, or toml table prefix
# ~ expands to $HOME. --workspace DIR overrides the project base.
